ai_summary: **Executive Summary: Agarwal Industrial Corporation Ltd. 32nd AGM Notice**  Agarwal Industrial Corporation Ltd.'s 32nd AGM agenda includes the approval of FY 2025-26 financials and a proposed Rs. 3.30 per share dividend. A major strategic pivot is highlighted by proposed amendments to the Memorandum of Association, enabling significant diversification into civil infrastructure, EPC, and toll collection from its core petrochemicals and logistics businesses, which will materially alter its business model and risk profile. Potential red flags include seeking omnibus approval for related party transactions for FY 2026-27 and approving remuneration for a non-independent director for advisory services, both of which warrant careful governance scrutiny.
